create_env_count_episode_wrapper: create an EnvCountEpisodeWrapper instance wrapping a gym environment to track episode counts
get_number_of_episodes: get the total number of episodes from the wrapped environment or return negative one
get_current_episode: get the current Episode object with episode id, scene id, start position and rotation
step_through_environment: step through the environment with an action and increment episode count on done
reset_environment: reset the wrapped environment with kwargs and increment the current episode counter
